name: smwmusic-newer-super-mario-bros-ds-cloudbolt-chasm-yoshi-s-island-samples
title: Newer Super Mario Bros. DS - Cloudbolt Chasm (Yoshi's Island Samples)
description:
This is a sampled port of the music from Newer Super Mario Bros. DS in the level Cloudbolt Chasm. It has the samples from yoshi's island. It is also a Minor remix of the yoshi's island athletic theme.
Works for thunderstorm levels or for levels with a dark theme.

Works with the lightning SFX.

The Zip file contains a version with echo and one without echo.
